description: PROPOSAL ONLY — R1 Codex Explorer lifecycle candidate hooks. Do not install automatically.
security_notes: This records lifecycle observations only; it does not establish strong runtime attestation.
The output file must be outside the repository, typically under RUNNER_TEMP.
request_hash/config_sha/provider environment values are bindings, not secrets.
A future trusted execution root plus Codex JSONL correlation is required before runtime_probe_attestation_verified may become true.
This is a project hook, not a managed hook. Strong attestation may require an independently administered managed-hook root or equivalent external execution root.
